links.comparator_used: Prespecified reference-standard grades (human lay and radiologist grading); lay participants' agreement with the same reference was κ=0.43
links.outcome: Agreement of ChatGPT-5 rubric grading and rubric-based distribution decisions with reference-standard grades for AI-generated patient-friendly radiology reports
links.effect: AI vs reference-standard grades: κ=0.44 (moderate) across 480 reports; rule-based distribution decisions from AI-assigned grades agreed 88.1% with those from reference-standard grades. Lay participants (n=80): κ=0.43, with 73.5% agreement between subjective and rule-based distribution decisions.
links.quote: Across 480 reports, AI had moderate agreement (κ=0.44) with prespecified reference-standard grades; rule-based distribution decisions using AI-assigned grades had 88.1% agreement with rule-based distribution decisions using reference-standard grades.

design_hint: rubric-based quality review of AI-generated patient-friendly reports before release
